text: AGI will not be possible with LLM. Stop spreading this fundamental inaccuracy. Read some works from Yann Le Cun to be updated about real AGI, not openai marketing AGI.
author: @HybridlifeOrg

text:
Of course not, but we haven’t had strictly LLMs for years now. What we have today are closer to world models inside each of the apps that OpenAI, Anthropic, etc. have put out.
People parrot the "it’s just next-token prediction" take while completely ignoring how these systems actually run now. They natively process vision and audio, execute code, verify their own work, and run through agentic feedback loops. LeCun is critiquing raw text models in isolation from four years ago. Nobody is claiming a basic text predictor is AGI by itself, but calling modern compound systems "just LLMs" is completely missing where the tech actually is.
